name: email_contacts
description: List or look up Jarvis's configured local email contacts in config/contacts.json. These recipient aliases are shared by send_email and Google Workspace Gmail sends/drafts. Use to inspect saved local recipients or verify a name before claiming it is missing. Optional query filters contact keys, display names, and email addresses case-insensitively. This does not search Google Contacts, Gmail messages, or memory, and it never sends mail or changes contacts. A missing local match does not mean an explicit email address cannot be used. Phone-only entries are omitted; truncated=true means more local matches exist.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive text to match against local contact keys, display names, or email addresses. Omit to list email-capable contacts.

limit.description: Maximum contacts returned, between 1 and 50. total_matches and truncated describe additional matches.
